description: This file defines classes and functions for Bluetooth HCI socket management, including Bluetooth address handling, Extended Inquiry Response (EIR), key management, and Bluetooth socket operations within the Thunder namespace.

classes.name: Address
classes.description: Represents a Bluetooth device address with utility methods for validation, comparison, and string conversion.

classes.name: EIR
classes.description: Encapsulates Extended Inquiry Response data, including device name, class, and UUIDs.

classes.name: KeyListType
classes.description: Template class managing a list of Bluetooth keys, providing add, validate, clone, and iteration functionalities.

classes.name: LinkKey
classes.description: Represents a Bluetooth link key with validation and string conversion methods.

classes.name: LongTermKey
classes.description: Represents a Bluetooth Long Term Key with validation and string conversion methods.

classes.name: IdentityKey
classes.description: Represents a Bluetooth Identity Resolving Key with validation and string conversion methods.

classes.name: SignatureKey
classes.description: Represents a Bluetooth Signature Resolving Key with validation and string conversion methods.

classes.name: HCISocket
classes.description: Manages Bluetooth HCI socket operations, including scanning, inquiry, advertising, and command execution.

classes.name: ManagementSocket
classes.description: Handles Bluetooth management interface operations, including device info, power, discoverability, pairing, and configuration.

methods.name: Ingest
methods.description: Parses buffer data into EIR object, extracting device name, class, and UUIDs.

methods.name: AddUUID
methods.description: Adds a UUID to the device's advertised UUID list.

methods.name: RemoveUUID
methods.description: Removes a UUID from the device's advertised UUID list.

methods.name: AddDevice
methods.description: Adds a Bluetooth device to the kernel's device list for autoconnection.

methods.name: RemoveDevice
methods.description: Removes a Bluetooth device from the kernel's device list.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description: Executes a Bluetooth command asynchronously with a callback handler.
